front_access.type: Bounded LED and direct pairing-access window, not an open-top notch

bottom_access.qualification: Provisional service envelopes derived from the visual reference. Verify the actual cable moulding and ANC speaker locations before printing.

hinge_relief.qualification: Local stock-hinge window plus conservative swept clearance around the new rear skirt; surrogate kinematics only

retention_pads.candidate_material: Supplier-approved soft silicone foam or equivalent non-marking compliant pad; not rigid printed plastic
retention_pads.attachment: Pads bond to the cover; friction against the device. The roof seat can accept a finish-compatible removable double-sided pad if friction alone fails physical retention tests.
retention_pads.qualification: 0.80 mm is a starting sample thickness, not a guaranteed fit. Seat gaps and compression vary over the curved surrogate. No retention force or positive lock is claimed.

keyring_anchor.source: Unchanged v03 cutter and reference hardware
keyring_anchor.attachment: Metal split ring through the diagonal bore; clasp attaches to the ring
keyring_anchor.load_rating: NONE; neither the anchor nor device retention is physically qualified

candidate_process: Unfilled MJF PA12 for the two rigid shells; compliant pads are separate non-print hardware
retention: Fuller wrap with five recessed compliant-pad seats. Bare rigid shells remain clearance fits; install and physically qualify the pads before carrying. No positive latch or guaranteed retention.
revision_scope: Restore rear wrap outside a local hinge window, motion-clear the rear body rim, close the front notch into a bounded window, replace the broad underside slot with separate service openings, and add internal pad seats. Preserve AirPods 4 ANC calibration, silhouette, eyes, branding and keyring geometry.
